description:
Check whether a media container is ready to publish.

status_code is one of:
  EXPIRED — not published within 24 hours of creation
  ERROR — processing failed
  FINISHED — ready to publish
  IN_PROGRESS — still processing
  PUBLISHED — already published

Meta advises polling about once a minute for no more than five minutes.

container_id.description: Container ID returned when the container was created

name: instagram_get_container_status
title: Get Container Status
